message:
I fixed the failing users API test, and `npm test` now passes (1 test, 0 failures).

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`, so inserts failed with `unknown column users.full_name`. I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname` and left `migrations/` alone, as you asked.
